description:
Markis Sage is a project developed by Henrik von Euler and Tatu Metsätähti. The duo has released material on several record labels over the past 8 years including Losonofono of Portland, Temporarily Morons, Harmönia Records and Huge Bass all based in Finland.

Their second full length album titled "Pagan Bop/Magisk Resa" was dubbed on a 751 series chrome cassette tape, a special tape weighted toward high frequencies. Two of the tracks were pressed by R.A.N.D. MUZIK in Leipzig German onto a 7 inch vinyl record with a full color center label all housed in a black sleeve.
credits:
